I haven't changed anything. The issue doesn't say which telemetry values to remove, and I can't tell from the code.

`generateNodesGraph` in `packages/workflow/src/telemetry-helpers.ts` builds the per-node telemetry (`INodeGraphItem` in `src/interfaces.ts`). Candidates for "not needed" are:
- **`position`**: the node's canvas coordinates, set on every node. The sticky-note `notes` entries also include position, height and width.
- **`id`**: the raw node id, set on every node. `src_node_id` is derived from it, so removing it could affect that field.
- **`workflow_id`**: the target workflow id on Execute Workflow and the workflow tool.
- **`domain`**: the full hostname recorded for HTTP Request v1. v2 already records only `domain_base` and `domain_path`.

Removing the wrong one would drop data that analytics may rely on. It would also mean rewriting about 260 `position`/`id` references in `test/telemetry-helpers.test.ts`. Tell me which fields to drop and I'll make the change and update the tests. If you have the Linear issue text, send it and I'll work from that.

I also tried to use Bash to check git history, and it was denied. I used the Read and Grep tools instead and did not retry Bash.
